brief.question: Rebuild the captured site (home, /chart/, /ideas/, /markets/, /brokers/) as an original-branded static web app whose centerpiece is an interactive candlestick chart with timeframes, drawing tools, indicators (MA, RSI, MACD, volume), symbol search and watchlist on simulated data.
brief.purpose: Recreate the charting experience for a non-coder with original name/branding.
constraints: Clean room: work only from screenshots and capture.json
brief.done_when: npm run build succeeds, all five pages exist at their paths, the chart page is fully interactive, and rebuild_check differences have been addressed where possible.

plan.title: Study the original's pages and measurements
Build the shared header, phone menu and footer
Build the interactive chart page
plan.why: candles, timeframes, drawing tools, indicators, symbol search, watchlist, alerts, replay

plan.title: Build the ideas, markets and brokers pages
Compare with the original and fix differences
plan.why: 54% alike overall; the rest comes from photos, logos and text that can't be copied

handoff: Round 2 done. Changes: content columns set (hero 1140/1000, section headings 664, ideas header 800, markets title 960, footer 9999); ideas cards use 16/14/12 px text; brokers hero spacing, dimmer horizon and smaller card text; phone chart starts with wider bars; Markets gained Corporate bonds (Short-term, Long-term, Floating-rate, Fixed-rate, Major 10Y bonds), ETFs (Most traded, Highest returns, Highest dividend yields, Highest AUM growth) and Economy (Economic indicators heatmap, Global inflation map, Economic Calendar). Latest rebuild_check: 54% overall (home 59, chart 63, ideas 44, markets 57, brokers 48, phone menu 97%); no missing headings remain. The rest of the gap is mainly photos, logos, idea screenshots and copyrighted text that were replaced on purpose. The original ideas screenshot also caught its sticky header mid-page, which wasn't copied. Scratch tools live in /tmp/cat (outside app).
